description: Paginated hand-picked kids gift catalog (~600 on amazon.se, ~560 English items on amazon.com). amazon.se: /dp product links with SEK price hints. amazon.com: English names, tagged amazon.com search links, no SEK prices (catalogMode search-ideas). OpenAPI: getCatalog.

country.description: ISO country of the shopper, e.g. US or SE (used when marketplace is omitted)

locale.description: User locale, e.g. en-US, sv, de. en-US switches to amazon.com when marketplace is omitted.

marketplace.description: Amazon storefront for the end user: amazon.com (US) or amazon.se (Sweden, default); also uk, de, fr… Order: marketplace → country → locale/Accept-Language (en-US ⇒ amazon.com) → amazon.se. amazon.se returns curated /dp product links; amazon.com returns English search links tagged for amazon.com.

name: get_catalog
title: Curated gift catalog
